name: Run on OS login
plain: An installed app can start when the person logs in to their computer.
meaning: Set by the person, not the site, via about://apps, or by IT policy. No site can enable it silently.

web.api: No web API; WebAppSettings policy run_on_os_login: blocked, run_windowed, allowed

access.prompt_ui: User toggles Start app when you sign in
access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

data.metric: An installed app can start when the person logs in to their computer.

limits.headline: Can start an installed app when you sign in, only if you choose
limits.user_action: You turn on Start app when you sign in, or your IT team sets it
can: Start the app when you sign in once you turn it on
Start through an IT policy on managed computers
Stay off until you or IT turn it on
cannot: Start for a site that is not installed
Work in Safari, Firefox or on phones
Be turned on from the page, since the person sets it
limits.reach_label: Each sign in, if you choose
limits.differs: Chrome and Edge on computers only, and still in testing. Not on phones, Safari or Firefox.

story.what_it_is: An installed web app can start by itself when you sign in to your computer.

marketing.name: Run on OS login
marketing.pitch: Lets installed web apps launch when you sign in, so chat or music apps are ready from the start.

story.for_you: You may see a prompt or a setting asking if the app should start when you log in. If you say yes, it opens right away each morning. You can turn it off in app settings.
story.for_makers: Makers want chat, music and work apps to be running and ready for alerts. It raises daily use. It uses memory and startup time, so a person must opt in.

use_cases.example: A chat web app starts at login so you do not miss messages.
A web music player opens at login and resumes your playlist.
A company dashboard app starts when staff sign in.
A web task app opens at login to show today's list.
A web game launcher starts at login to check for updates and friend invites.
A web meeting app starts at login to be ready for calls.
A web health monitor app starts at login to track your day.

technical_bounds: A manifest member was only proposed

history.change: Run on login on Windows, Linux, macOS
